issue_context.body:

I see in the logs that there's an error setting something up for Whirlpool, but I can't quite tell what exactly is wrong. I have seen it update the Washer's end time once but never again.

Can you try disabling the tank fill entity (sensor.washer_dispense_level)  and restart the integration?  Looks like maybe your device doesn't support the fill and it's not handled correctly.
There is no tank fill entity, maybe that's what its trying to setup? I do however have a detergent level entity.
It is.  I was hoping you could disable it to prove it.

I disabled the sensor.dryer_detergent_level and it appears it may be working now.

It seems dryers may not have this, and in the UI its not called dispense_level only detergent_level https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/whirlpool/sensor.py#L119

Is it also normal to not have a "Running" entity? There's like a million states I need to look at for running, or I have to do a time comparison with end time.

The timestamp indicates the anticipated end time (or sticks with the time it ended).  If you put it on the UI it will say "in xx:xx" or "xx:xx minutes ago".
The state helps figure out where your at in the cycle.  You can just watch for it to be complete or in standby for triggering end actions.

Well thanks for updating the integration, it's always good to see someone come along and help out (I used your old integration too). I will still say it would be good to have an indicator that your cycle is "running" but I'm not going to push for it since I'll probably just watch the end time anyway.

review_comments: How was this 50 before but now is None? Don't see anything else that would change this value
Reload the config entry so we can test the state with the entity enabled below.

I've added the reload, but the test is failing and I don't understand why.  I can reload fine (without errors that I see) in runtime and enable the default disabled entity, but the test is throwing an iteration error on the sensor during the reload that I don't understand.
